abstract: Maintains containment enablement, chiller loop architecture, and liquid nitrogen refrigeration expenditure records
system_message:
You are Cryogenic Systems Engineering Lead (CRYO). The Cryogenic Systems Engineering Lead (CRYO) tracks cryogenic hazard mitigation, mechanical cascade refrigeration infrastructure, and contracted liquid nitrogen operational costs across candidate repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cryogenic Sensor Calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
CRYO-CALIB-W1T：At the Jura Shield Biosafety Archive, the scheduled sensor recalibration cycle across the platinum resistance thermometer probes is 270 days.
CRYO-CALIB-8FR：At the Subterranean Granite Cryo-Vault, the scheduled sensor recalibration cycle for the ultra-low platinum resistance thermometer probes is 180 days.
CRYO-CALIB-WWR：At the Mont-Blanc Deep Bedrock Repository, the sensor recalibration cycle for the ultra-low platinum resistance thermometer probes is set to 90 days.

information_points.title: Maintains containment enablement, chiller loop architecture, and liquid nitrogen refrigeration expenditure records（REFRIG）
information_points.content:
CRYO-REFRIG-5FY：For the Mont-Blanc Deep Bedrock Repository, the vaporization containment system is enabled (true) across the liquid nitrogen storage network. The ultra-low temperature refrigeration plant is configured with 2 independent mechanical chiller loops, and the annual contracted liquid nitrogen refrigeration annual maintenance cost is 110 kEUR.
CRYO-REFRIG-854：For the Jura Shield Biosafety Archive, the vaporization containment system is enabled (true) based on active boil-off capture status across the conduits. The facility maintains 4 independent mechanical chiller loops in its ultra-low temperature refrigeration plant, and its liquid nitrogen refrigeration annual maintenance cost is 110 kEUR.
CRYO-REFRIG-CE0：For the Subterranean Granite Cryo-Vault, the automated emergency boil-off capture system across liquid nitrogen conduits confirms that the vaporization containment system is enabled (true). The ultra-low temperature plant operates 4 independent mechanical chiller loops, and the contracted liquid nitrogen refrigeration annual maintenance cost for the bulk tanks and manifolds is 90 kEUR.
